g.text: UC.27 - Threat Mitigation & Workstation Remote Containment
User submits question to Hybrid AI Copilot
Display read-only security refusal notice & safe vector answer
Return Knowledge Graph results & citations to user
IT Admin detects anomalous workstation in Monitoring View
Click Emergency Kill Switch & enter admin password
Display containment confirmation on Admin Dashboard
AST Tokenizer inspects clauses for forbidden keywords
(CREATE, MERGE, DELETE, DETACH, SET, REMOVE, DROP, CALL dbms)
Write CRITICAL event BLOCKED_CYPHER_MUTATION to audit_logs
Fallback to safe Qdrant Vector RAG retrieval
EMERGENCY_KILL command over secure WSS channel
kill command for immediate execution on reconnect
Write CRITICAL event WORKSTATION_KILL_SWITCH to audit_logs
Execute read-only MATCH ... RETURN query on Neo4j
AEGIS Agent closes file watcher streams, stops worker
